messages.subject: [RESULT][VOTE] July 2026 PR of the Month
messages.body:
Hey All,

Voting has closed for July 2026 PR of the Month! Thank you to everyone who
participated. Here are the results:

Winner: PR #69295 — Add airflow-ts-pack bundle build tool for TypeScript SDK
@guan404ming (Guan-Ming Chiu) — 4 votes
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/69295

This month's PR of the Month winner adds the airflow-ts-pack bundle build
tool, laying the groundwork for the upcoming TypeScript SDK. Congrats,
Guan-Ming!

Runners-up:

   - PR #61550 — Add the option to select bundle version parameter on dag
   run trigger endpoint by @itayweb (Itay Adler) — 2 votes
   - PR #68479 — Add Vertex AI Agent Engine operators (Create, Get, Query,
   Update, Delete) by @AlejandroMorgante (Alejandro Morgante) — 1 vote
   - PR #67725 — Type asset_expression in the REST API so the UI does not
   cast through unknown by @Anuragp22 (Anurag Pappula) — 1 vote

The winner will be featured in the upcoming July issue of the Airflow
Community Newsletter, which goes out on Monday. Subscribe here: <
https://www.astronomer.io/apache-airflow-monthly-newsletter/>
--
Briana Steel
